argument: The twelve unequal segments must read as one radial material body before they read as four interactive sites. The central aperture, seam grain, unequal radii, and phase changes must carry the image without interface chrome.

With labels, readout, controls, hint, and prose hidden, the first view must leave v048's wash, v049's sheet, and v050's relief. It should read as a new temporal material object, not a generic radial diagram.
The visitor must press, wait, and release. Pointer, touch, keyboard, and the deterministic pulse control must offer equivalent meaningful paths; no hover-only action may carry the work.
A short or mistimed release must remain geometry-neutral. Only the quiet phase may change actual segment and aperture geometry; status and phase arcs cannot substitute for production.
The timing window must be a real state condition, not explanatory theatre. The engine must store elapsed phase and refuse out-of-window releases without altering the prior body.
Four phase slips must compound in one ring. Lift must reconstruct the exact preceding geometry and release must return to the deterministic quiet seed.

Generated p5.js Canvas 2D radial segments, aperture, seam grain, and material shadows are the medium. No screenshot, imported illustration, external font, or decorative brush simulation may carry the work.

p5.brush is translated from programmable material production into phase-locked release. No brush preset, watercolor, hatching, grain, source palette, source composition, source code, example, or API surface is reproduced.
v051 changes representation, composition, encounter, temporal behavior, and viewer task: a radial body and timing gate replace the recent wash, sheet, and relief grammars.

Delete v051 if short or mistimed pressure commits, if the ring only recolours, if segments or aperture stay exact, if later slips reset, if lifting is inexact, or if the blind form is just a generic radial diagram.
